trap.label: planejar relatório
trap.wrong: The report talk about why was the study done.
trap.right: The report explains why the study was done.
trap.why: Em perguntas indiretas o brasileiro mantém a ordem de pergunta. Em inglês, ordem direta: why + sujeito + verbo.

opts: I will explain why failed it.

fix.right: I will explain why it failed.

fix.wrong: The report say how many participated.
fix.right: The report says how many participated.

fix.wrong: We explain how was it done.
fix.right: We explain how it was done.

rewrite.prompt: Torne indireta: “Why did it fail?” (I will explain…)
rewrite.answer: I will explain why it failed.

rewrite.prompt: Torne indireta: “How was it done?” (The report explains…)
rewrite.answer: The report explains how it was done.
